about: AceVector (formerly Jasper Infotech) runs an asset-light digital commerce group: the Snapdeal value e-commerce marketplace, the Unicommerce e-commerce enablement SaaS business (Uniware, Shipway, Convertway) and the Stellaro Brands consumer brands business (Rangita stores). FY26 revenue from operations was Rs 510.38 crore, with Marketplace 57.54% and SaaS 40.04% of revenue. Snapdeal delivered 25.98 million units to 12.16 million annual transacting customers in FY26, mostly in Tier 2+ and non-metro cities.
sector: E-commerce (value marketplace, e-commerce SaaS and consumer brands)

objects.purpose: Funding a portion of marketing and business promotion expense of the Marketplace (Snapdeal) business
Funding technology infrastructure costs of the Marketplace business
Inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes (capped at 35% of gross proceeds incl. Pre-IPO placement)

promoters.background: Kunal Bahl and Rohit Kumar Bansal are the founders and Joint Managing Directors. Starfish I Pte. Ltd. (corporate promoter, 30.11%) is the promoter selling shareholder, offering up to 27,607,082 shares in the OFS. Pre-offer holding is on a fully diluted basis: Starfish 30.11%, Kunal Bahl 12.19%, Rohit Kumar Bansal 10.93%. Post-offer promoter holding is 39.71% (Starfish 20.31%, Kunal Bahl 10.23%, Rohit Kumar Bansal 9.17%); promoter group B2 Professional Services LLP holds a further 9.12%.

concentration.note: No single external customer contributes 10% or more of revenue. Revenue mix FY26: Marketplace 57.54%, SaaS 40.04%, Consumer Brands 2.51% (pre-elimination segment shares).

litigation_note: Proceedings against the Company: 3 criminal, 12 tax, 4 statutory/regulatory and 1 material civil, aggregating about Rs 61.11 crore (quantifiable). Criminal proceedings also involve promoters/directors Kunal Bahl and Rohit Kumar Bansal, and income tax notices have been issued to Kunal Bahl as principal officer. Contingent liabilities are only Rs 0.07 crore. Auditor reports carried a FY26 remark on excess managerial remuneration of Rs 0.15 crore at one subsidiary and audit trail/backup modifications.
strengths: Snapdeal is among the top two pure-play value marketplaces in India, serving 12.16 million annual transacting customers and 25.98 million delivered units in FY26.
Unicommerce is the largest e-commerce enablement SaaS platform in the transaction layer, with revenue up from Rs 103.58 crore to Rs 204.34 crore in two years.
Marketplace NMV grew 37.30% in FY25 and 25.71% in FY26, reaching Rs 1,093 crore.
Losses are narrowing: adjusted EBITDA improved from Rs -39.16 crore in FY25 to Rs -15.94 crore in FY26, and operating cash outflow fell to Rs 1.80 crore.
Asset-light, zero-inventory marketplace model with no bank debt at March 2026.
Strong customer stickiness: repeat customers are 69.65% of customers and 82.91% of delivered units, and 89.83% of units come through the app.
Revenue from operations grew 29.2% in FY26, with SaaS rising to 40% of revenue, which diversifies away from the marketplace.
Founder-led with marquee investors, and shared services and procurement synergies across the three businesses.

risks.title: Persistent losses
risks.detail: Restated losses of Rs 45.51 crore (FY26), Rs 126.31 crore (FY25) and Rs 51.30 crore (FY24). Net worth was negative in FY24 and the company has never been profitable; EPS is Rs -1.32 in FY26.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow every year
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was Rs -54.85 crore, Rs -27.35 crore and Rs -1.80 crore in FY24, FY25 and FY26. FY26 financing cash flow was also negative at Rs 6.04 crore.

risks.title: Heavy marketing spend and weak marketplace unit economics
risks.detail: Marketplace marketing spend was Rs 84.40 crore in FY26 (14.67% of total expenses). Marketplace adjusted EBITDA was Rs -50.25 crore in FY26 and Rs -48.01 crore in FY25, and IPO money (Rs 132 crore) mostly funds more marketing.

risks.title: Valuation looks demanding
risks.detail: The company is loss-making, so P/E is not ascertainable. At the Rs 32 offer price the post-offer market cap is about Rs 1,741 crore, roughly 3.4x FY26 revenue. The only listed peer with a P/E is FSN at 462.50x. Rs 133 crore of the Rs 420 crore offer is an OFS.

risks.title: Marketplace revenue has lagged industry growth
risks.detail: Marketplace revenue was Rs 252.89 crore in FY24, Rs 249.87 crore in FY25 and Rs 293.68 crore in FY26, growing slower than NMV as seller fees were lowered. It is 57.54% of revenue and faces larger, better-funded competitors.

risks.title: Control of Unicommerce rests on governance rights, not shares
risks.detail: AceVector owns only 26.13% of Unicommerce but consolidates it (SaaS is 40% of revenue). Losing the right to appoint a majority of its board would remove it from consolidated results.

risks.title: Litigation involving company and promoters
risks.detail: Against the Company: 3 criminal, 12 tax and 4 regulatory cases and 1 material civil case, aggregating about Rs 61.11 crore. Criminal complaints also name promoters Kunal Bahl and Rohit Kumar Bansal.

risks.title: Weak liquidity and unappraised use of proceeds
risks.detail: Current ratio was 0.93 in FY26 (0.76 in FY25). Use of the Rs 287 crore fresh issue is not independently appraised, and up to 35% of gross proceeds can go to unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes.

notes: Prospectus (final): price band Rs 30-32, offer price Rs 32. FY24-FY26 restated consolidated; Rs million converted to Rs crore. PAT is restated loss attributable to parent holders (company-reported loss for the year). net_worth and reserves are parent equity (other equity), consistent with NAV Rs 2.21. FY24 net worth negative so RoNW/ROE/debt_equity for FY24 null; RoNW FY25 -110.24% and FY26 -59.54% per document (weighted avg -79.82%). EBITDA is computed as pre-exceptional loss before tax plus finance costs plus D&A; company-defined Adjusted EBITDA is in kpi.other. PBT is after exceptional items. Borrowings are bank overdraft only. cash_and_bank excludes current investments. P/E at floor and cap is NA (negative EPS). Pre-IPO placement of Rs 13.00 crore at Rs 36 per share deducted from fresh issue (Rs 287 crore). Anchor reservation is 45% of offer (59,062,500 of 131,250,000 shares). ROCE, ROE, and FY24 ratios not given; null.
